changelog:
Major rewrite from DeckGlobalizer v2.1.1:

- Now a full 4-stage pipeline (Sense Pass → McKinsey Translation → Layout Audit → Handoff)
- Swappable PROFILE block (palette, fonts, glossary, slide-offset)
- Page-by-page execution with per-slide checkpoint
- McKinsey style baseline + extensible reference samples
- Font-name suffix audit, structural-anchor detection
- Discrete -0.1pt font compression, line-spacing fallback
- Bidirectional PPT ↔ Excel sync
- Companion-file lock detection
- 10 standalone helper scripts
- Polish-only mode for single-language decks

Renamed from 'deckglobalizer' to 'deck-pipeline'; old slug redirects.
